CommitPulseSummaries.reason: Trusted atomic Pulse scheduler writer admits at most 1000 typed candidates, reads only native workspace schedule/feature and recipient schedule/preferences/push decisions from the installed logical source, and dynamically admits both the native and locked canonical pulseDeliveryCursors preimages. One transaction preserves complete cursor advancement, notification/delivery appends, journal, notification-state and event hooks; its private cursor source is installed with the captured commit stamp before summary publication. Existing issues/content and unrelated metadata bodies are not hydrated. Legacy/warm/reloaded row, cursor, webhook/realtime, state and audit differentials, exact nil/empty/operator-default policy and actual scheduler cases, rollback/retry/cancellation/quota tests, 432001-to-512001-byte cursor with 1000 recipients and stale-peer no-op, persistent SQLite twice and targeted race all passed. The caller retains its literal off-mode callback.
